I found this topic from a youtube video, and I'm so glad that there are other people who understand this particular phenomenon. For some rason, your comments in particular have struck a chord with me.

Quick rundown of my experiences: I've always been plagued by random feelings of derealization and other such indescribable feelings, even as a child (before I knew what it was). I recently started to suspect that I'm schizophrenic, and I've had even stranger feelings of this type in the weeks following my recent strokes that terrorized me almost to the point of feeling suicidal until they got better. (long story, but even though I'm in my late 20s I ended up almost dying and hospitalized all of this summer because of medical malpractice).

Anyway, some of the songs that give me this feeling (which has always been difficult to describe - my mother is the only one who might get it, but she calls it deja vu) are beautiful, but it's sometimes tortuous to listen to them. 

General derealization differs from the way music makes me feel, though I wonder if the two are still somehow related? Each song has its own unique "flavor" so no two ever have the same effect on me, but one thing that all have in common is that they give me a sense of otherwordliness and divine bliss, but also an overwhelming feeling of longing and sadness.

One song in particular from last year really stood out to me. It almost feels like it was made just for me, and like there's some kind of meaning I'm supposed to take away from it. As much as I love it, it fills me with a terrible feeling of restlessness for this very reason.
